title: Yummy Spicy Japanese Pork Fritters
description: Crispy, spicy pork fritters with a tangy kick, perfect as a hangover cure snack.
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground pork, soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, chili flakes, grated ginger, miso paste, salt, pepper, egg, and potato starch; mix until fully blended.
Let the mixture rest for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Heat a non-stick skillet or shallow pan over medium-high heat and add about 2 tbsp of high-heat oil such as peanut or canola.
Spoon 1-2 tablespoon portions of the pork mixture onto the hot oil, flattening slightly to form fritters.
Fry each side for 3-4 minutes until golden brown and crisp, turning once.
Transfer cooked fritters onto paper towels to drain excess oil.
While frying, drizzle a splash of rice vinegar over the pan to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits.
Serve the fritters hot with a side of pickled ginger and a drizzle of soy sauce or spicy mayo.
Optionally, garnish with chopped scallions or sesame seeds for extra flavor.
Enjoy immediately as a savory snack or lunch item.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
